sources.paper: Lyons et al., Magnetophoretic transport of functionalised iron-oxide nanoparticles through biomimetic hydrogels and extracellular matrix
sources.limitation: The accessible main article does not supply a batch-matched B, grad(B), B*grad(B), moment or susceptibility tuple for every LG/IG/HG Table 1 condition.

sources.paper: Stephen Lyons, Development of Magnetic Nanoparticle based Gene Therapies for Pancreatic Cancer
sources.source_locator: PDF pp. 94-97, Eq. 3.1, Eq. 3.3 and Table 3.1
sources.limitation: The thesis values refer to its PEG-coated particle experiments; equivalence to the S1 2026 PEG2000 8 nm and 11 nm LG/IG/HG batches and magnetic geometries is not documented.

sources.paper: Fatin-Rouge, Starchev and Buffle, Size Effects on Diffusion Processes within Agarose Gels
sources.source_locator: Results and discussion; 1.5% agarose size-dependence experiment
sources.limitation: Different tracer chemistry and agarose concentration; not an exact Fe3O4/0.3% agarose transport calibration.

sources.paper: Moncure et al., Relationship between Gel Mesh and Particle Size in Determining Nanoparticle Diffusion in Hydrogel Nanocomposites
sources.source_locator: Article abstract, results discussion and author manuscript
sources.limitation: No machine-readable or pointwise diffusion table with uncertainty was acquired; no values are promoted into the present material system.

sources.paper: Myrovali et al., Arrangement at the nanoscale: Effect on magnetic particle hyperthermia
sources.limitation: Particles are aligned during agarose cool-down; this is not a quantitative fixed-pre-gelled transport benchmark and does not by itself close a 2D continuum kernel.

sources.paper: Basak et al., Transport characteristics of nanoparticle-based ferrofluids in a gel model of the brain
sources.source_locator: PDF pp. 9-26, gel methods, Figure 7 and Figures S5-S8
sources.limitation: The paper explicitly describes gel transport as qualitative. Figure 7 is normalized mean pixel intensity, not a calibrated particle-number density observation, and no raw image time series or uncertainty table was found.

required_evidence: same magnetic-core batch or traceable batch-equivalence measurement
condition-specific B and grad(B) for LG, IG and HG
uncertainty for susceptibility/moment and magnetic material volume
compatible particle chemistry and size ratio
source-backed magnetic moment law for both particle sizes

s4_digitization_audit.curve_axes: time [h] versus average normalized pixel value
blockers: No calibrated observation model maps normalized mean pixel value to particle-number density rho.
No plotted uncertainty bars or pointwise uncertainty table are supplied.
Image acquisition changes gel orientation temporarily and averages a finite optical field of view.
Upstream D/M, magnetic force and W parameters are not independently locked, so digitizing the curve cannot enable a parameter-free joint validation.
